title: Goblin trail

sourceRecords.title: 4 · Goblin trail and traps
read: The goblin trail narrows under the trees. Broken twigs and churned earth show several small creatures passed this way, with heavier marks among them. The road disappears behind you.

Each disturbed patch offers a place to slow down and look, while the thicker growth limits what you can see ahead. You can keep the heavier marks in view, check the ground before committing your weight, or pause to decide how closely you want to follow.

brief: Narrow goblin footpath heads northwest away from wooded road through thick thickets, small footprints and two drag marks in damp earth, broken vegetation. Ordinary forest, no hidden traps outlined or readable route signs, no captured people or goblins visible.
